question: What befalls those unrested here?
premises: But who here have not come to rest resort to measured consciousness.
They are in every way refuted by birth-death-born delusions.
inference: The unrested, resorting to measured consciousness, fall to birth-death delusions.
plain_english: But those who here have not come to rest resort to measured consciousness; they are in every way refuted by birth-death-born delusions.
